_comment: Floors sit a point below the 2026-09-17 post-phase-2 baseline (overall lines 93.9 / functions 94.5; lib 94.9, installer 94.6, hooks 92.3, mcp 99.1) so a real regression fails and normal churn does not. arms_allow is empty on purpose: every dispatcher case arm is executed by a test (79/79), and an arm that stops being dispatched must fail the gate rather than earn an entry. An entry added here needs a reason and is removed when a test dispatches the arm — the gate fails on a stale one.
